context: Riku tells Aoi about a crowded train commute.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (乗る/走り/避け/パス/多かっ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今朝の電車、人が多かったよ。
lines.en: This morning's train had a lot of people.
lines.style: tired teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うわ、満員電車に乗ったの?
lines.en: Whoa, did you ride a packed train?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、ホームまで走りで間に合ったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I made it by running to the platform.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 混む時間を、避けられないの?
lines.en: Can't you avoid the crowded hours?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 早いのに乗れば、避けられるかな。
lines.en: If I ride an earlier one, maybe I can avoid it.
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 定期のパスは、買ったの?
lines.en: Did you buy a commuter pass?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、パスを使って乗ってるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I ride using a pass.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 人が多かったら、無理せず避けてね。
lines.en: If it's crowded, don't push it — avoid it.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm caring closing delivery throughout
